Callout.Name: Obstruction of the Highway
Callout.Message: Vehicle parked on double yellows blocking a bus route.

Script.Line: I am loading. The van is here and I am loading it.
Five minutes. I have been here five minutes.
Where am I supposed to park? There is nowhere to park.

Lines.Approach: The buses cannot get through and the driver is nowhere. It needs moving.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
